Producent van schoonmaakproducten

Interesse in deze vacature? Wij horen graag van je, contacteer ons op het nummer 056/26 52 10 of mail jouw CV naar menen@unique.be

Jobomschrijving

If you are ambitious, self-motivated, hardworking and a team player and interested in growing your career with an International FMCG business, please read through our job opportunity.

Your responsibilities are
	
• Improve efficiency of filling lines by developing, managing and introducing a variety of improvement actions with as objective to increase productivity and quality of the output of the filling lines. You make an analysis of production processes and report about waste in quality and efficiency.	
• Solve critical issues by analyzing root causes on the short term and make proposals for solutions on the long term in order to guarantee and optimize filling production and this by engaging and motivating team members and let them gain autonomy in their job roles.	
• Check continuously the filling production processes in terms of quality, input, output, safety and ergonomic circumstances	
• Make proposals, together with the production team and the team coordinator, of technical improvements and guarantee that the improvements are implemented with as objective to improve efficiency, quality, lead time and to maintain cost leadership. You make sure the proposals are in line with the operational excellence strategy. You are responsible for the improvement projects, both technical and organizational, from A to Z.	
• Act as back up of the filling production manager in day-to-day activities of the department.

Studies and working experience
	
• Industrial engineering degree without experience or bachelor with experience	
• Experience in a production environment	
• Experience in project management is an asset
Technical skills
	
• Good knowledge of Dutch	
• Knowledge of English / French	
• Knowledge of TPM / Lean / Operational Excellence	
• Knowledge MES system	
• Knowledge MS Office / Excel
Specific skills
	
• Analytic	
• Innovative	
• Communicative skill	
• Setting of priorities	
• Problem analysis

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will be responsible for organising and supporting meetings, conferences and events while ensuring a seamless experience for employees, visitors and guests. You will coordinate event logistics, prepare meeting spaces, provide office support and act as a key contact to ensure successful event delivery in a dynamic workplace environment.

Client Details

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in Diegem close to a train station in a new modern building.

Description

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).

jobs.occupation: In-House Legal Counsel - Flemish Brabant - Self-employed
jobs.description:
Our client is a niche advisory organisation that supports individuals in managing key aspects of their professional and financial activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the legal side of transactions from start to finish
• Draft, review and negotiate contracts and related documentation
• Analyse tax and social law implications within transactional files
• Identify risks, inconsistencies and optimisation opportunities
• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders throughout the process
• Maintain rigorous structure, documentation and follow-up
• Provide tailored, high-quality advice (no "one-size-fits-all")

• Master of Laws with 2-8 years' experience, ideally in M&A or tax
• Strong negotiation skills and the ability to challenge positions when needed
• Excellent attention to detail and a sharp ability to detect inconsistencies
• Robust tax reflexes and a naturally transactional mindset
• Professional, assertive and confident - able to stand your ground
• Pragmatic, clear, no-nonsense communicator
• Comfortable with variable workload and able to self-manage peaks
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English
• Proactive, structured and ownership-driven

Our client is a well-established Belgian technology and entertainment company with over 30 years of history and a leading position in its sector. Operating across multiple European countries, the group combines innovative proprietary technology with a strong customer-centric approach to deliver digital and retail entertainment services.

With approximately 1,500 employees across Europe and nearly 500 employees based at its Belgian headquarters, the company continues to invest heavily in technology, innovation and international expansion. Recent developments include platform migrations, consolidation of international operations and the continued enhancement of internally developed digital products.

The legal department consists of a close-knit team of legal and regulatory specialists working collaboratively across several areas, including regulatory affairs, corporate law, commercial contracts, public affairs and employment law. The team offers a supportive environment where expertise sharing, autonomy and professional development are highly valued.

The company culture is entrepreneurial, dynamic and project-driven. Employees benefit from direct access to decision-makers, significant ownership of their responsibilities and the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives with tangible business impact.

Jobomschrijving

As Regulatory Officer, you will act as the primary legal and regulatory specialist for the Dutch market.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Serving as a key point of contact with Dutch authorities and regulatory bodies
• Coordinating regulatory interactions in collaboration with compliance, legal and external advisors
• Managing license maintenance, renewals and related regulatory obligations
• Overseeing all statutory notification requirements and submissions to Dutch authorities
• Monitoring regulatory developments and assessing their impact on business activities
• Translating regulatory requirements into practical internal processes, controls and guidelines
• Providing legal advice on commercial initiatives, marketing campaigns, partnerships and new product features
• Supporting internal stakeholders on regulatory risk assessments and compliance matters
• Coordinating litigation matters involving customers, business partners or authorities
• Managing escalated complaints with potential regulatory implications
• Advising on terms and conditions, promotional rules and responsible measures
• Supporting customer support, compliance and responsible gaming teams on legal matters
• Ensuring customer-facing processes remain aligned with applicable regulations
• Creating and maintaining internal regulatory guidelines and training materials
• Collaborating with stakeholders across multiple countries and business functions

• Master's degree in Dutch Law
• Between 1 and 5 years of professional experience in a legal or regulatory environment
• Experience with Dutch law is essential
• Experience gained in private practice, in-house legal departments, regulatory bodies or compliance functions is welcomed
• Fluent Dutch and English, both written and spoken
• French is considered a strong asset
• Strong interest in regulatory and compliance matters
• Ability to analyse complex legal situations and provide pragmatic solutions
• Autonomous while maintaining a collaborative mindset
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment
• Willingness to travel occasionally to the Netherlands when required
• Good command of Microsoft Office tools and digital collaboration platforms

Personality-wise, our client is looking for someone who is transparent, approachable and communicative. The ideal candidate is comfortable acknowledging mistakes, seeks continuous improvement and enjoys working closely with colleagues in a relatively young and dynamic team environment.

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in the centre of Brussels close to the metro, bus and train stations in a new modern building.

jobs.description:
Our client is a technology and engineering services company supporting businesses in the development of innovative products and industrial solutions. With a multidisciplinary team of experts, the company assists customers throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept development and prototyping to industrialization and production.

Jobomschrijving

The Business Development Manager - Technology / Engineering Sector will have the following responsibilities :

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy within your assigned region, aligned with the company's growth objectives.
• Build and manage a portfolio of B2B clients within industrial and manufacturing sectors.
• Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities related to product development, engineering services, industrialization, and outsourced manufacturing solutions.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and relationship building to proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure.
• Coordinate awarded projects in collaboration with internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment on timelines, budgets, quality requirements, and customer expectations.
• Collaborate with international teams to create commercial and technical synergies across the organization.
• Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify new business opportunities and growth drivers.

• Minimum 5 years in a similar position: business development or sales experience within a technical, engineering, or industrial environment.
• Proven experience selling engineering, R&D, product development, industrialization, or manufacturing-related services.
• Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with a results-oriented mindset.
• Passion for technology, innovation, and long-term customer partnerships.
• Fluency in French and Dutch, with professional proficiency in English.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

• Eagerness to learn with a conscientious and responsible approach

• Strict adherence to safety rules and flexibility in working hours

As a Pre-Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the meticulous assembly and disassembly of tooling on our state-of-the-art roll forming lines. Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

A typical day sees you inspecting your own work for precision, collaborating with team members, and operating both conventional and CNC-controlled machines. You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Eagerness to learn, conscientiousness, and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and safely

• Flexibility and willingness to work in a 2-shift system

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, order, and cleanliness

• Technical background or equivalent experience

You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service.

You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a CNC Turner/Programmer? This role places you at the heart of precision manufacturing, where you'll operate and program CNC turning machines using advanced Heidenhain and Siemens control systems. Your expertise will ensure the production of high-quality, custom-made spare parts for various industrial applications.

A typical day involves collaborating with a team of five skilled professionals, programming and operating CNC machines, and ensuring finished products meet rigorous quality standards. You'll also engage in measuring and inspecting workpieces and occasionally assist in hydraulic cylinder repairs. A clean, organized workspace is a must to maintain safety and efficiency.

If you're passionate about precision and innovation, apply today to join a team that values expertise and teamwork!

• Proven experience as a CNC Turner/Programmer

• Proficiency in Heidenhain and Siemens control systems

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

• Experience in custom machining and measuring techniques

• Good level of English

• Willingness to work in a day shift, starting at 07:00 or 08:00

As a Pistol Painter, you'll play a crucial role in our vibrant team, ensuring every vehicle part meets our high-quality standards. You'll be responsible for preparing parts, mixing paint, and applying it with precision. Your keen eye for detail will ensure that every vehicle leaves our facility looking its best.

Your day will be hands-on from start to finish. Begin with checking parts for assembly, then move on to sanding, degreasing, and masking. You'll mix paint in our state-of-the-art lab, spray it on truck bodies, and conduct thorough final inspections to ensure perfection.

Ready to bring your painting skills to life in a dynamic work setting? Apply today and contribute to a team that values quality and craftsmanship!

• Eye for detail and color precision
• Experience as a repairer/painter
• Fluent in English
• Strong communication skills and teamwork ability
• Passion for technique and craftsmanship
• Valid driving license B

Work with a dedicated team to bring blueprints to life, ensuring that every measure is executed to perfection.

Picture your day starting with a collaborative briefing with your team, followed by hands-on work where you prepare formwork, place and finish concrete, and ensure every detail aligns with design specifications. You will be reading construction plans, placing reinforcements, and ensuring site cleanliness, all while maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

Are you ready to take your construction career to the next level? If you are motivated, physically fit, and willing to learn, we want you! Apply now and become a part of a team that values skill and dedication.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international company operating in a customer-centric retail and services environment. To support its continued growth and commitment to service excellence, the company is looking for a Customer Support & Operations Coordinator to join its central support team.

In this role, you will act as a key point of contact between customer service teams, operational stakeholders, and business clients, ensuring smooth daily operations and contributing to the continuous improvement of customer processes.

• Handle and resolve complex customer cases escalated by first-line support teams, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolutions.

• Deliver administrative support to business customers, including managing customer communications, maintaining records, and processing account-related information.
• Ensure accurate management of customer data and documentation within internal systems.
• Analyze recurring incidents, identify trends, and propose improvements to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
• Collaborate with multiple departments to ensure seamless communication and service delivery.
• Contribute to ongoing process optimization initiatives and support continuous improvement projects. 
 

We are looking for a Customer Support & Operations Coordinator that :

• Previous experience in a customer service, customer support, operations, or administrative coordination role.
• Strong organizational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to manage complex customer situations professionally.
• Comfortable working with different software applications and business systems.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to prioritize tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
• Fluency in Dutch and French is essential; a good knowledge of English is considered an asset.

As a logistics operator at Agristo Wielsbeke, you are responsible for monitoring and managing logistics processes, resolving malfunctions, performing technical interventions, and working with modern systems in an automated cold storage environment. You work in a night system and have a technical affinity.

As a logistics operator, you are responsible for:
 
• Monitoring and managing the processes within the logistics department to ensure continuity. 
• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility. 
• Interpreting data trends and reporting process information with the aim of contributing to improvement actions for the logistics department.
 
• You have a technical affinity.
